test_title: PYST 35: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 21 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75e7fe933f91175907c9a253dad62acca6e226e196ffa683c417652e33a16b9e.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

1) Corner dark shaded triangle shifted corner to corner in anticlockwise direction in every next figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13c385b04c0f4f92ffc10386d549924dd7e19b47b5d67d131e30806849f1189f.png] 

2) Outside circle is shifted 90º in anticlockwise direction and turn shaded to unshaded then shifted 90º clockwise direction and turn unshaded into shaded and so on in next figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6251c53926617ead19fdcfb0b44dea4f1235d0c04a0a7f5c49196114f0820e4d.png] 

3) Inside circle is shifted 90º in clockwise direction then shifted 90º anticlockwise direction so on in next figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8fe1e758eeec8c009afd5d4678322c4276560d2032166c33f078ee3610ea889c.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
